title: Can't Stay Motivated for More Than a Week? 🧠
description:
Can't stay motivated for more than a week? Here are three simple fixes: start with just two minutes, tell one person your goal, and build a routine instead of relying on mood. The full top ten is in today's long video on the channel.

#money #business #motivation #habits
topic: Three simple fixes for losing motivation after a week
